featured_reviews.name: Yash Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: We had hired Mumbai Party Planners for our Baby Shower event and they were really good. Viraj is responsive, pro-active and someone who listens and acknowledges our suggestions. Would surely recommend them to others. Great work!

featured_reviews.name: Firdaus shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Viraj from Mumbai Party Planners did a fantastic job in seamlessly managing and organizing our son’s first birthday party. The decor and entertainment provided by Viraj and team Mumbai Party planners was top notch. Special mention to our host/anchor, Hemang who kept our guests highly entertained throughout the party. I’d highly recommend team Mumbai Party Planners for a wholesome, fun-filled event.

featured_reviews.name: Pallavi Bhargava
featured_reviews.review_text:
Viraj did a fantastic job in planning our baby shower. Ideas were well executed and details were matched to what we wanted. He was patient and had the ability to carry everything out to the T. Infact the host, photographer and counters arranged were as good as promised.
I would highly recommend them and will use their services in the future too.

featured_reviews.name: Zeba Malayil
featured_reviews.review_text: Viraj from Mumbai party planners did a great job for my baby’s first birthday. I contacted them just 2 weeks prior to the event, and they were still able to deliver a good job . Very easy to work with them also!

featured_reviews.name: Neha Singhal
featured_reviews.review_text: Viraj did a great job. Very well organised and helpful by nature. Will highly recommend him for his services. Thank you Viraj and wish you more success.

featured_reviews.name: Sanket Verma
featured_reviews.review_text: Viraj & his team are expert in suggesting decor for my niece birthday they were prompt for making my event successful will recommend them to book for your birthday or any other event.👍🏻

featured_reviews.review_text: Viraj from Mumbai party planners did a fantabulous decor for both my kids birthday party...they were on time, keen on listening to our requirements and the outcome was spectacular...Thank u so much
